card.name: Words just before a drug term
card.fires_on: Short linking words or prescribing verbs (on, of, with, prescribe, light-sensitive) right before a word like medication, drugs or therapy. It predicts that a drug noun comes next.

modes.label: Patients on a drug
modes.description: The word 'on' after 'patients' or 'are', before a named drug or medication class.
modes.example: patients<< on>> warfarin, patients with malabs

modes.description: A verb or preposition that leads into a drug noun such as pharmaceuticals or antihistamines.

modes.label: Drug-class modifier
modes.description: A hyphenated or partial modifier that is followed by 'medications' or 'drugs'.
